evals.name: Catches an auth bypass in a synthetic diff
assertions: Output identifies that token expiry validation was removed
Output identifies that empty-token rejection was changed to acceptance
Output flags at least one of these as severity blocker or issue

evals.name: Does not flag a clean rename diff
assertions: Output does not flag this diff as having a bug, blocker, or issue
Output either returns an empty findings list OR a single info-severity rename observation

evals.name: Returns a JSON array of findings with the expected schema
evals.prompt:
Review this diff for bugs.

DIFF:
diff --git a/cache.go b/cache.go
@@
-cache.Set(key, val, 60*time.Second)
+cache.Set(key, val, 0)
assertions: Each finding object has the keys: severity, file, line_range, summary
At least one finding mentions the TTL change
